name: manual_b796e5
claim: 'openclaw models auth login' takes --agent as a flag on the PARENT 'models auth' command, not on the 'login' subcommand itself — 'openclaw models auth login --agent X --provider Y' fails with 'does not recognize option --agent', the correct order is 'openclaw models auth --agent X login --provider Y'. This login command also refuses to run without a real TTY and cannot be scripted around ('requires an interactive TTY... use paste-token when token auth is available'); paste-token needs the raw token value, there is no mechanism to copy another agent's existing credential into a different agent's isolated auth store. The '--agent' flag on the separate 'openclaw agent' (singular, invocation) command works differently and IS valid there — verified both behaviors live, do not assume flag position is consistent across sibling openclaw subcommand trees.
conditions: openclaw models auth login agent flag position TTY interactive OAuth paste-token no credential reuse

decisions.notes: 2026-07-11: gave the user an incorrect command for gemini-coder's antigravity OAuth login (put --agent after login); user caught the CLI's own rejection and reported it back. Verified the correct flag position and confirmed --agent DOES work correctly on 'openclaw agent' (singular) by testing it live.
